$comment: Licences the website's npm packages may have, checked on every build by scripts/third-party-licenses.mjs,
which also writes public/third-party-licenses.txt from them. Only permissive licences (and the OFL, for the
fonts) are allowed for every package; anything else is a decision about one package, recorded below.
An entry applies to the package named by its key, or to every package starting with it if it ends in *.
'declared' is the licence exactly as the package states it: if a new release states anything else, the
entry no longer applies and the build fails until someone reads the new licence. 'license' replaces a
declared licence that is not SPDX; 'allow' allows more licences for this package only; 'text' is the
upstream licence (in licenses/) of a package that ships none; 'notServed' says why a package that ships
no licence text needs none here: nothing of it reaches the site.

pagefind.reason: The site's search: pagefind/ (its UI, scripts and WebAssembly) is served. The npm package has no licence file; licenses/pagefind-LICENSE is the LICENSE of github.com/Pagefind/pagefind.

@pagefind/*.reason: Pagefind's UI (@pagefind/default-ui) and its per-platform indexer, which writes the served pagefind/ files. Same repository and licence as pagefind.

@img/sharp-libvips-*.notServed: libvips, the native image library sharp uses to resize images while the site is built; it runs on the build machine and none of it is served.
@img/sharp-libvips-*.reason: Build tool only, dynamically linked by sharp, unmodified: the LGPL puts no obligation on the site.

@img/sharp-wasm32.reason: sharp compiled to WebAssembly with libvips, a fallback for platforms without a native build. Build tool only; none of it is served.

lightningcss.reason: The CSS minifier of the build. Its output is the site's own CSS, not its code, and MPL-2.0 binds only changes to its own files.

lightningcss-*.reason: lightningcss's per-platform native binary. Build tool only.

@astrojs/compiler-binding-*.notServed: The native Astro compiler, which turns the site's .astro files into HTML while it is built.

@bruits/satteri-*.notServed: A native Markdown processor used while the site is built.

@rolldown/binding-*.notServed: The native bundler (Rolldown) of the build.

@napi-rs/wasm-runtime.notServed: Loads the build tools' WebAssembly fallbacks on the build machine.

am-i-vibing.notServed: Used by Astro's command line to detect the terminal it runs in.

process-ancestry.notServed: Used by am-i-vibing in Astro's command line.

piccolore.notServed: Colours the output of Astro's command line.

boolbase.notServed: Used by CSS selector matching while pages are built (svgo, Starlight).
